questions.question_text: Which is longer: a $1.62$ m paddle or a $158$ cm paddle?

options.why: Compared 158 with 1.62 without first using a common unit.
Rounded both converted lengths to the nearest metre before comparing, making each $2$ m.
Assumed different units prevent comparison even after conversion.

questions.solution_text:
$1.62\text{ m}=162\text{ cm}$
$162\text{ cm}>158\text{ cm}$
The $1.62$ m paddle is longer.

questions.question_text: Which ribbon is longest: $760$ mm, $75$ cm or $0.77$ m?

options.why: Compared the written numbers $760$, $75$ and $0.77$ without converting to a common unit.
Multiplied centimetres by $100$ instead of $10$, converting $75$ cm to $7500$ mm instead of $750$ mm.

questions.solution_text:
$75\text{ cm}=750\text{ mm}$
$0.77\text{ m}=770\text{ mm}$
$770\text{ mm}>760\text{ mm}>750\text{ mm}$
The $0.77$ m ribbon is longest.

questions.question_text: Which hiking section is longest: $1.085$ km, $1087$ m or $108600$ cm?

options.why: Multiplied kilometres by $10000$ instead of $1000$, converting $1.085$ km to $10850$ m instead of $1085$ m.
Compared the written numbers without converting to a common unit, choosing $108600$ because it is the largest number.

questions.solution_text:
$1.085\text{ km}=1085\text{ m}$
$108600\text{ cm}=1086\text{ m}$
$1087\text{ m}>1086\text{ m}>1085\text{ m}$
The $1087$ m section is longest.

questions.question_text: Which branch is longest: $0.56$ m, $54$ cm or $550$ mm?

options.why: Treated $550$ mm as $5.5$ m instead of $0.55$ m.
Rounded every converted length to the nearest whole metre before comparing.

questions.solution_text:
$0.56\text{ m}=560\text{ mm}$
$54\text{ cm}=540\text{ mm}$
$560\text{ mm}>550\text{ mm}>540\text{ mm}$
The $0.56$ m branch is longest.

questions.question_text: Which strip is longest: $2.07$ m, $208$ cm or $2090$ mm?

options.why: Multiplied metres by $10000$ instead of $1000$, converting $2.07$ m to $20700$ mm instead of $2070$ mm.
Multiplied centimetres by $100$ instead of $10$, converting $208$ cm to $20800$ mm instead of $2080$ mm.
Rounded each length to the nearest whole metre before comparing, making all three $2$ m.

questions.solution_text:
$2.07\text{ m}=2070\text{ mm}$
$208\text{ cm}=2080\text{ mm}$
$2090\text{ mm}>2080\text{ mm}>2070\text{ mm}$
The $2090$ mm strip is longest.

questions.question_text: Which distance is longest: $0.1024$ km, $102.3$ m, $10250$ cm or $102450$ mm?

options.why: Multiplied kilometres by $10000$ instead of $1000$, converting $0.1024$ km to $1024$ m instead of $102.4$ m.
Divided each of the other lengths by an extra factor of $10$, obtaining $10.24$ m, $10.25$ m and $10.245$ m.
Compared the written numbers without converting to a common unit, choosing $102450$ because it is the largest number.

questions.solution_text:
$0.1024\text{ km}=102.4\text{ m}$
$10250\text{ cm}=102.5\text{ m}$
$102450\text{ mm}=102.45\text{ m}$
$102.5\text{ m}>102.45\text{ m}>102.4\text{ m}>102.3\text{ m}$
The $10250$ cm distance is longest.
